summary: Paycom Software filed an 8-K announcing a $0.375/share quarterly cash dividend and a new $2.0 billion stock repurchase plan with no expiration date. The dividend will be paid June 8, 2026 to holders of record May 26, 2026. Repurchases may be executed via open-market, privately negotiated, or Rule 10b5-1 programs at the board's discretion. No break fee or premium applies; this is a pure capital-return initiative. The company may use cash or its credit facility to fund repurchases. Watch for execution pace and any suspension triggers based on market conditions; no risk-arb angle as there is no M&A.
